head: 1f82b73a1019930f419492e3e742a96bd43f374e
finding: Manual RESTART terminal loses Serial path and can report terminalQueued=1 with no sink queued
condition: USB-only control; BLE disabled/disconnected, Wi-Fi sink off; local RACK successfully admitted
path: TransportQueue returns ESP_OK without descriptor when !bleEnabled && !wifiEnabled
ProcessDescriptor has BLE/Wi-Fi calls but no Serial call
impact: Old explicit Serial restart marker is removed; new RAM cache disappears at reset. No terminal attempted on Serial. This is distinct from normal possible packet loss.
recommendedRegression: Execute actual publish path with Serial-only and inspect Serial admission calls; include USB rejection, network-disabled no-op and per-sink status
